profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which the company's site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12 covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The site says IXL is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics, with interactive questions, awards, and certificates. The company describes the product as personalized learning supported by a comprehensive K-12 curriculum, individualized guidance, and real-time analytics.

IXL Learning also offers Vocabulary.com, listed as an adaptive vocabulary practice product for students and teachers. IXL itself is tracked as an adaptive practice and diagnostic tool for teachers, students, and families. Reported pricing for IXL includes a classroom license from $299/year for 25 students and family plans from $9.95/month, both from a secondary source. Vocabulary.com district licenses are quoted individually, and one Florida district approved a 3-year contract for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
